subject.title: [Bug]: WeChat channel session permanently corrupted after ingesting binary file attachments

question: Should this report remain open as distinct WeChat binary-ingestion evidence while the shared session-conflict and placeholder trackers remain open, or should maintainers fold it into one canonical issue now?
rationale: The report spans core reply-session state, provider/tool-result placeholder projection, and an external WeChat plugin media path; automation cannot safely choose the ownership boundary without maintainer scoping.

options.title: Keep Distinct WeChat Evidence
options.body: Leave this issue open until the shared fixes land and the WeChat binary-attachment workflow is checked against the external plugin path.

options.title: Fold Into Placeholder Tracker
options.body: Close or retarget this to the canonical placeholder tracker if maintainers decide the WeChat trigger is only another manifestation of tool-result media placeholder degradation.

options.title: Route To Plugin Owner
options.body: Move the remaining work to the external WeChat plugin if core session and provider invariants are confirmed fixed.

recommendation.title: Keep Distinct WeChat Evidence
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the shared fixes land and the WeChat binary-attachment workflow is checked against the external plugin path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest current signal across the AI package refactor and WeChat boundary docs, while session and provider specialists are likely implementation owners.
